about_the_game:
Crisálida is a short narrative game blending visual novel and point-and-click elements to explore themes of grief, memory, and self-discovery.

You play as Íris, a woman trying to move forward after a personal loss during the isolation of a global pandemic. Through hidden object searches in interactive scenes and environmental storytelling, you will guide her as she reconstructs the past and defines her future.

Every interaction reveals fragments—some comforting, others painful. But not every memory is what it seems. The story unfolds through multiple paths, leading to five distinct endings.

A sensory and sonic experience, every choice adds a new sound to the score. The final composition, revealed only at the end, echoes the decisions made and becomes a sonic portrait of Íris’s journey.

Featuring hand-painted digital scenes and an all-female development team behind the story and original concept, Crisálida invites you to reflect on what we remember, what we forget, and what we carry with us—even in silence.

🌸 Highlights

  • A short and intense experience: Approximately 1 hour per playthrough.

  • Five different endings: Rewarding player curiosity and meaningful choices.

  • Hidden narrative content: Discover secrets that expand the story beyond Íris’s perspective.

  • Deeply sensory: Featuring the striking voice of Thais Durães and compositions by César Lima.

  • Dynamic soundtrack: A score that grows and evolves with every route discovered.

  • Handcrafted aesthetic: Digital art with an artisanal feel and immersive soundscapes created by MenyeB.

  • A love letter to resilience: An intimate story of self-discovery written by Laís Faccin.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game addresses sensitive themes such as loss, grief, death, family conflicts, and suicidal ideation. Its purpose is to encourage reflection and empathy. If you experience excessive discomfort, we recommend taking a break and seeking support from friends, family, or healthcare professionals.

This is a work of fiction. Names, characters, places, and incidents are products of the studio's imagination or are used fictitiously. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) / Windows 8 / Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU @ 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or DirectX 10 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a mouse and keyboard.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit recommended)
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or DirectX 11 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a mouse and keyboard.
